390 14/6/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
June 13th 1918
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
It is reported that a certain section of the
Kuomintang party in Shanghai are not satisfied with the
present arrangements in Peking and they intend to make
further trouble. They are now considering means to
smuggle arms into the interior and it has been suggested
to employ Japanese hawkers to do this work.
It is reported that the Arsenal detectives have held
a meeting as it was rumoured that their services would
be dispensed with. At the meeting they decided to
petition General Yang to retain them in office until
they can find other employment.
Zee Koh Liang 徐國標has sent one of his officers to
Tientsin to enlist eighty recruits for the local police.
General Yang has received a telegram from Liu Kwan
Yung, Minister of the Navy requesting him to arrest
two naval officers named Mau Zoong Fong 毛仲芳 and Woo
Say Zung 吳賽仁。
The Asiatic Daily News ceased publication on June 12th.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

AM
Entered on 13.

390 16/6/14
上海工部局。
1918年6月13日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据报，上海国民党某派系对北京目前的局势安排不满，意图进一步制造事端。他们目前正在策划将武器走私至内地的手段，有人提议雇用日本小贩来执行此项任务。

据报，兵工厂的侦探们举行了一次会议，因为有传言称他们的服务将被终止。在会议上，他们决定向杨将军请愿，请求在他们找到其他工作之前保留其职务。

徐國標（Zee Koh Liang）已派遣一名下属前往天津，为当地警察招募八十名新兵。

杨将军收到海军总长刘冠雄（Liu Kwan Yung）发来的电报，要求逮捕两名海军军官，分别为毛仲芳（Mau Zoong Fong）和吳賽仁（Woo Say Zung）。

《亚细亚日报》（Asiatic Daily News）已于6月12日停刊。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

AM
于13日录入。
